trends.name: Iran Military Escalation & US Fighter Jet Downed
trends.summary: US F-15E fighter jet shot down over Iran with crew status unknown—first direct US military loss in Iran conflict. Marks major escalation in geopolitical tensions with immediate implications for energy markets, defense spending, and risk sentiment across equities and commodities.

trends.name: Jobs Report Disconnect: March Beat vs February Downrevision
trends.summary: March payrolls beat expectations (+178K) but February was revised down to -133K loss, largest since December 2020. Creates Fed policy confusion: headline strength masks underlying labor market weakness and native-born worker decline of 194K, suggesting structural employment challenges.

trends.name: Treasury Yields Rise Amid Iran War & Growth Concerns
trends.summary: Mortgage rates surge for 5th consecutive week following Iran conflict and better-than-expected March jobs data. Yield curve steepening reflects mixed signals: geopolitical premium, Fed hold expectations, and inflation concerns from potential supply disruptions via Strait of Hormuz.

trends.name: Defense Spending Surge Under Trump Administration
trends.summary: Trump budget proposal includes $1.5 trillion defense resources for FY2027, 5-7% military pay raises, and 10% non-defense cuts. Iran conflict provides political tailwind for major defense budget expansion, benefiting aerospace/defense contractors amid heightened geopolitical risk.

trends.name: US Services PMI Contracts; Economic Slowdown Signals
trends.summary: Final US Services PMI fell to 49.8 (contraction) versus expected 51.1, signaling manufacturing and service sector weakness. Combined with downrevised February jobs data, indicates potential Q2 GDP deceleration despite March headline strength—recession concerns resurface.

trends.name: Federal Debt Interest Payments Approach $1 Trillion
trends.summary: US net interest payments projected to exceed $1 trillion in FY2026, up from $882B in FY2024. Rapidly deteriorating fiscal position constrains policy flexibility and pressures yields. Drives demand for hard assets and commodities as inflation hedge against fiscal deterioration.

trends.name: AI Sector Consolidation: OpenAI & Salesforce Leadership Dynamics
trends.summary: OpenAI's TBPN acquisition signals aggressive M&A in agentic AI space; Salesforce upgraded to Buy on Rule of 44 outperformance potential. Indicates major winners in enterprise AI consolidation wave, offsetting broader market concerns about Big Tech leadership fatigue.

trends.name: Big Tech Earnings & Market Leadership Questions
trends.summary: Stock market snapped 5-week losing streak but Big Tech's absence as leader raises sustainability questions. Rotation away from mega-cap concentration amid valuation concerns and mixed earnings signals (Hims, Snowflake positioning). Sets tone for Q1 earnings season.

trends.name: Energy Supply Chain & Strait of Hormuz Disruption Risk
trends.summary: Iran escalation threatens Strait of Hormuz shipping lanes and global energy supply. Commodity prices surging (crude, natural gas); private aviation fuel costs up 20%. Third and fourth-order effects include central bank stress (gold selloffs for liquidity), inflation re-acceleration, and structural supply shock concerns.

trends.name: Immigration & Labor Market Composition Shift
trends.summary: Foreign-born workers surged +806K to record highs while native-born workers declined 194K (flat since 2019). Reflects structural labor market composition change with wage pressure implications and political implications for Trump administration—signals tightening labor markets despite overall gains.

trends.name: Tech Infrastructure & Grid Security as Geopolitical Asset
trends.summary: JPMorgan identifies outdated US electricity grids as national security risk amid geopolitical tensions. Represents growing market opportunity in grid modernization, infrastructure investment, and energy resilience spending. Aligns with Trump's infrastructure agenda and defense buildup priorities.

trends.name: Legal Challenges Threaten Big Tech's Section 230 Shield
trends.summary: Meta and Google face court cases bypassing 30-year legal protections under Section 230. Regulatory/legal headwind for social media platforms could force content moderation changes, increase compliance costs, and impact profitability. Contributes to Big Tech valuation pressure.
